LineItems.role: The table of line items on the record

LineItemCode.role: Identifier for the thing a line refers to

LineItemLabel.role: Printed name of the thing a line refers to

LineItemCount.role: How many units a line covers

LineItemUnit.role: Unit the count is expressed in

LineItemAmount.role: Amount for a single unit on a line

RecordNumber.role: Identifier assigned to the record as a whole

notes: Invented vocabulary for tests. Exercises the shapes the loader has to handle: 8 tags, a collection, a repeating row, a two-level parent chain, and both structural kinds. No example values and no content from any real document.
